items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I'll give you my own personal appraisal of his band. His band had such entertainers in it as Bill Robinson, Noble Sissel...

ctx.x: I don't want to keep you more in a minute. I was trying to ask, when I was young, the only Negro band I ever heard of is the James Reese Europe band in the Army. Did yours compare? Was it anything bigger or special more than say the band like you had? Well, I don't try to be modest and say mine wasn't as good as this. I mean, actually in your opinion. That's right. Was your band in a class better or good?

I'll give you my, I'll give you my own personal appraisal of his band. His band had such entertainers in it as Bill Robinson, Noble Sissel, a few other dancers, a few other singers, a few other people whom in my estimation I considered in the entertainment world. But for martial music and the kind of military music, there was only one Negro band over there that topped my band. And that band was Will Vaudry's band.
